statement: AMD claims its Helios rack-scale platform delivers 15% better compute performance than Nvidia's Vera Rubin and 30% more tokens per dollar than Nvidia's servers.
why: If a credible second source of rack-scale accelerators is competitive on cost per token, buyers gain negotiating leverage and the single-vendor structure of the market starts to loosen.

impact.mechanism: A competitive alternative rack platform expands total accelerator supply and pressures incumbent pricing on a cost-per-token basis.

evidence.excerpt: provides 15% better compute performance than Vera Rubin
These are AMD-sourced performance claims relayed by the article, not independently measured.

confidence.basis: Vendor-sourced performance claims relayed by one secondary outlet and explicitly not independently verified.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend rising -> rising); sources: Investing.com (AMD Q2 2026 earnings call transcript), Yahoo Finance
